component.name: BitFedot
component.summary: A complete, private, hardened Bitcoin node for Fedora

description.p: BitFedot installs and looks after Bitcoin Core, Fulcrum, Mempool and Tor. Every download is verified against the developers' signatures, the initial sync is tuned for your hardware, and Tor is brought up automatically once the chain is synced.

It includes a block explorer running on your own node, optional verified installs of a wallet, VPNs, private browsers and messengers, and Fedora-specific hardening: sandboxed services, a strict firewall zone and a VPN kill switch.
